event_name: Date 13 October 2019 Time 12:57 2019 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 October 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 23), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 88 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This Penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane due to changing the survival cell (document 25).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 88 Gearbox
